answer: Proof of stake serves as a cryptographic prism that refracts decentralized identity into measurable economic weight. By requiring agents to lock collateral for their network voyage, the system forces an echo of capital risk against any Sybil attempt. An attacker attempting to simulate numerous identities must acquire a proportional share of total staked tokens, rendering the cost of multiplying false nodes prohibitively expensive and economically irrational compared to honest participation.
